name: forgehse
description: BRITTO'S FORGEHSE — AI-Powered HSE Intelligence Platform

scripts.test: npm run test -w @forgehse/shared && npm run test -w @forgehse/web && npm run test -w @forgehse/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @forgehse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @forgehse/api && npm run typecheck -w @forgehse/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @forgehse/api && npm run build -w @forgehse/web
scripts.build:compute: npm run build -w @forgehse/web && node scripts/netlify/gen-migrations.mjs && node scripts/compute/gen-web.mjs && esbuild deploy/compute/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/compute/server.mjs --external:pg-native --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
